scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and finite verification. Xu--Wong Lemma 3.4 recognized as a previously established special case; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite subsets of a nonnegative torsion-free lattice and a fixed two-point summand only. Familiar Fibonacci and binary-dilation ingredients; priority under older morphological terminology not excluded.
title: Rank-refined inverse fibers of two-point addition in reduced finitary power monoids
